sentences.text: A line of position, or L O P, is a line somewhere along which your boat must be.
The most common is a bearing to a charted object, like a lighthouse or tower, converted to true and drawn through the object.
Two charted objects in line, a range, give a very accurate L O P with no compass error at all.
A radar range to a charted point gives a circle of position around it.
Even a depth contour can serve as a rough L O P.
Label each one with the time above the line and the true bearing below it.
